name: r7-c05-red
why: R7-C-05 RED: r7-fence-green minus the apply_rescan fence (5b00729d does not reverse at HEAD). Init withholds the GObjects it found (a2) so apply_rescan has something to apply, Extra Scan hands it back (a1); the apply sleeps 2 s after Aura::Init (b) and the mailbox's post-UE5_Init path 1.5 s (c), each only while its %TEMP% flag file exists. Without the flags it behaves as the base tree.

subs.new:
Aura::Init(g_cachedGObjects);
                { char r7tp[MAX_PATH]; DWORD r7n = GetTempPathA(MAX_PATH, r7tp);   /* STAGING */ if (r7n && r7n < MAX_PATH - 40) { strcat_s(r7tp, "ue5dump_apply_widen.flag"); if (GetFileAttributesA(r7tp) != INVALID_FILE_ATTRIBUTES) { Sein::Info("PIPE:cmd", "STAGING apply-widen"); Sleep(2000); } } }
